ks_test.description: p-value < 0.05 indicates statistically significant distribution shift against baseline.

psi.description: PSI < 0.10: Stable, 0.10-0.25: Moderate Drift, > 0.25: Significant Drift.

missingness.description: Alert if column null percentage increases by >15% relative to baseline.

score_distribution.description: Alert if model score distribution or alert volume shifts noticeably.

metadata.protocol: Zero test-set access. Reference distributions computed exclusively from training data.
